entities.summary: Agency for Sustainable and Operational Social Security (Azerbaijani: Dayanıqlı və Operativ Sosial Təminat Agentliyi ) is a governmental agency which was created by the order of President in order to improve governance in employment, social protection, labor. It is guided by the Constitution of the Republic of Azerbaijan, international treaties to which the Republic is a party, laws of the Republic, decrees and orders of the President, decisions and resolutions of the Cabinet of Azerbaijan, other normative legal acts and agency's Charter.
